reasons.baby-rattle: The ring-and-dot silhouette repeats several stronger cases and does not retain a specific rattle body at 16px.
reasons.bee-frame: The broad outer lobes read as a bear head or bag before a beekeeping frame.
reasons.camera-trap: The rectangular eye is generic camera shorthand and lacks a field-specific silhouette.
reasons.friendship-bracelet: The near-perfect ring is less specific than the woven relationship cases already admitted.
reasons.heirloom-love-spoon: The bowl, handle, and carved terminal collapse into a medal or magnifying glass at native size.
reasons.luna-moth: The angular wings still read as a star or leaf cluster before a moth.
reasons.matcha-whisk: The reduced silhouette reads as a shovel or goblet rather than a bamboo whisk.
reasons.memory-spool: The striped puck remains abstract and does not earn a recognizable spool noun.
reasons.potters-rib: The circular scraper repeats the gallery's ring construction without enough pottery-specific contour.
reasons.stage-trapdoor: The isometric block reads as another generic cube beside stronger map, crate, and collet cases.
reasons.tree-frog-cling: The revised limb cluster still reads as a jellyfish or leaves before a frog at 16px.
